name: Persistence - Registry Run Key (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one named value under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run pointing at a harmless no-op command. Removes only that named value, never the Run key itself.
telemetry: Registry value creation under HKCU Run key
detection: Registry Run Key / Startup Folder monitoring

name: Persistence - WMI Event Subscription (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic __EventFilter, __EventConsumer, and __FilterToConsumerBinding under root\subscription, filtering on a synthetic Win32_LocalTime interval class, never a sensitive event class. Removes all three in reverse creation order.
telemetry: WMI subscription object creation under root\subscription
detection: WMI event subscription monitoring (Sysmon event ID 19/20/21 or equivalent)

name: Persistence - Local Account Creation (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one local user account with a random password and a per-run synthetic name. Removed by undo; undo tolerates the account already being absent.
detection: Local account creation monitoring (Windows event 4720 or equivalent)

name: Persistence - Account Manipulation via Group Membership (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates its own local user account (independent of pers-03) and adds it to the built-in Users group only -- never Administrators or any admin-equivalent group. Undo removes group membership then deletes the account; tolerates either already being absent.
detection: Account manipulation / group membership change monitoring (Windows event 4732 or equivalent)
